links.comparator_used: Unfiltered predictions, where the model outputs every prediction without confidence-based filtering
links.outcome: Prediction accuracy versus prediction coverage after filtering low-confidence predictions
links.effect: No numeric effect is given in the abstract. The abstract says only that the trade-off between coverage and accuracy was analyzed.
links.tradeoff: Filtering out low-confidence predictions reduces the share of cases the model predicts (coverage) in exchange for accuracy on the retained cases.
links.quote: The effect of confidence-based filtering is also analyzed to examine the trade-off between prediction coverage and accuracy.
